steps.title: Only officers see this link
steps.body: Everything behind it is club-wide and real — this tour won't have you change anything. Open it.

steps.title: The pending queue
steps.body: Task completions and time logs over two hours wait here. Clearing this often is the single most useful thing you do as an officer.

steps.title: Approve, or reject with a reason
steps.body: A silent rejection teaches someone to stop logging time, and then the club loses the data. The reason costs you ten seconds and keeps the record honest.

steps.title: What every event type is worth
steps.body: Change these rarely, and announce it first — members plan around these numbers, and moving them quietly makes every past total mean something different.

steps.title: Integrations
steps.body: Google Drive, and the connections that let files and meeting notes flow in. Set once, then mostly left alone — but when uploads start failing club-wide, this card is the first place to look.

steps.title: Roles, project membership, and GitHub logins
steps.body: Role is what governs permissions — rank never does. Someone can be a COSMONAUT and still not be an officer.

steps.title: Officers see every project
steps.body: Including ones they aren't a member of. Use that to unstick things, not to browse.

steps.title: Two things to remember
steps.body: Clear the queue often, and change the numbers rarely and in public. Everything else on this page can wait.
